· SMA100/200 ($0.08/$0.09) position - Mixed mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (7.2%) + Current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (84.7→59.4) - Cooling from overbought, consolidating in neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0029→0.0010) - Continued improvement, no bearish reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $0.08) - Bandwidth at 47.55% is wide, consolidating around the mid-band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.08) - Based on Pivot (PP) and SMA20/EMA20.
· Swing resistance ($0.09) - Aligns with current price, potential for short-term bullish breakout.
· 5-day/20-day price range pattern - Consolidation phase, no clear Higher Low or Lower High formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.33) - Reduced confidence in price movement, sluggish activity.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) - Consider entering on increased volatility and volume.
